tasks.title: Keep accented titles readable
tasks.contract: Repair slugify(text). Convert a string to a lowercase ASCII slug: use Unicode NFKD normalization to preserve decomposable accented Latin letters as ASCII, discard combining marks, replace each run of other non-alphanumeric characters with one hyphen, and strip leading/trailing hyphens. Keep digits. Return an empty string when there are no ASCII letters or digits. Examples: 'Café déjà vu!' becomes 'cafe-deja-vu'; 'Hello___World' becomes 'hello-world'.
